description: This is a JUnit test class for the Patient domain object in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the Patient class, including construction, identifier management, and identifier ordering.

classes.name: PatientTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various methods of the Patient domain object in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: patient_shouldConstructCloneWhenPassedPatient
methods.description: Tests the copy constructor of the Patient class, ensuring it correctly clones the object.

methods.name: addIdentifier_shouldAddIdentifierToCurrentList
methods.description: Tests adding identifiers to a patient, including duplicate prevention and ordering.

methods.name: addIdentifier_shouldNotFailWithNullIdentifiersList
methods.description: Ensures adding an identifier does not fail even if the identifiers list is initially null.

methods.name: getIdentifiers_shouldNotReturnNull
methods.description: Checks that the getter for identifiers does not return null.

methods.name: addIdentifier_shouldNotAddIdentifierThatIsInListAlready
methods.description: Verifies that adding a duplicate identifier does not increase the list size.

methods.name: removeIdentifier_shouldRemoveIdentifierIfExists
methods.description: Tests removing identifiers, including multiple cases and ensuring proper list update.

methods.name: removeIdentifier_shouldTestIdentifierCollectionChanged
methods.description: Advanced test for collection order and voided status impacts on identifiers list.

methods.name: getActiveIdentifiers_shouldReturnPreferredIdentifiersFirstInTheList
methods.description: Validates the ordering of active identifiers with preferred ones appearing first.
